summary_en: 5,602,700 shares (32.32% S/O) of Genova Inc. transferred from founder/CEO Toshiki Hirase to Hirase Shoten (his asset management company) on June 11–12, 2026. Hirase Shoten's stake increases from 7.69% to 40.00%, becoming largest shareholder. Transfer qualifies as a regulatory acquisition act under FIEA Article 167(1). Founder retains executive role.
summary_jp: GENOVA Inc.の5,602,700株（発行済株式総数の32.32%）を創業者兼CEO平瀬智樹氏から資産管理会社の平瀬商店へ2026年6月11日～12日に譲渡。平瀬商店の持株比率が7.69%から40.00%に上昇し筆頭株主となる。金融商品取引法第167条第1項に基づく買集め行為に該当。
